title: BREAK Statement
description: Learn how to use BREAK to exit a WHILE loop immediately.

data.text: The BREAK statement immediately exits a WHILE loop. It can only be used inside a WHILE loop.

data.title: BREAK in a WHILE loop
data.content: Exits the loop when counter reaches 4.
data.code:
WHILE Boolean_expression
BEGIN
    -- statements
    IF condition
        BREAK;
    -- other statements (skipped if BREAK is hit)
END

data.title: BREAK exits loop at 4
BREAK Key Points
points: BREAK exits the innermost WHILE loop immediately.
It can only be used inside a WHILE loop.
All statements after BREAK in the loop are skipped.
BREAK is often used with IF to check an exit condition.
